title.zh: 刻蚀窗口：同时守住四件事
title.en: Etch window: keep four things under control together

subtitle.zh: 选择比、CD、Profile与均匀性必须一起优化
subtitle.en: Selectivity, CD, Profile and uniformity must be optimized together

body.zh: 选择比、CD、Profile与均匀性必须一起优化
body.en: Selectivity, CD, Profile and uniformity must be optimized together

body.zh: 只追求Hard Mask“刻得慢”；可能换来残留、侧壁异常或下层损伤。
body.en: Pursuing only a “slow-etching” Hard Mask; may cause residue, abnormal sidewalls or damage to underlying layers.

body.zh: HM Open；• PR提供Mask预算；• HM被选择性开口；• Target在开口完成前受保护；• 终点后仅需控制短暂暴露/；过刻损伤
body.en: HM Open; • PR provides the Mask budget; • HM is selectively opened; • Target is protected until opening is complete; • After endpoint, control brief exposure /; overetch damage

body.zh: Target Etch；• Target被主要刻蚀；• HM相对慢耗并维持CD/Profile；• 选择比是相对关系
body.en: Target Etch; • Target is primarily etched; • HM is consumed relatively slowly and maintains CD / Profile; • Selectivity is a relative relationship

body.zh: Stop Layer保护；• Endpoint与Over-Etch；保证Target完成；• 同时限制Stop Layer损伤
body.en: Stop Layer protection; • Endpoint and Over-Etch; ensure completion of the Target etch; • Limit Stop Layer damage at the same time

body.zh: Litho CD；（先刻CD）；HM CD → Target Top CD →；Bottom CD；（底部CD）
body.en: Litho CD; (Prior-etch CD); HM CD → Target Top CD →; Bottom CD; (Bottom CD)

body.zh: 逐级Shrink（收缩）；逐级Enlarge（扩大）
body.en: Progressive Shrink; Progressive Enlargement

body.zh: CD偏差可能逐级缩小或扩大，影响最终图形尺寸与一致性。
body.en: CD deviation can accumulate as shrinkage or enlargement, affecting final pattern dimensions and consistency.

body.zh: Ideal Vertical；Taper；Bow；Footing/；Notching
body.en: Ideal Vertical; Taper; Bow; Footing /; Notching

body.zh: 良好（理想）；风险增加（异常）
body.en: Good (ideal); Increasing risk (abnormal)

body.zh: Center-Edge；低；Across-Wafer 均匀性
body.en: Center–Edge; Low; Across-Wafer uniformity

body.zh: Dense-Isolated；（微负载效应）；Dense（密集）；ISO；（孤立）
body.en: Dense–Isolated; (Microloading effect); Dense; ISO; (Isolated)

body.zh: 不同图形密度导致刻蚀速率差异，；影响CD与Profile的一致性。
body.en: Different pattern densities cause different etch rates,; affecting CD and Profile consistency.

body.zh: 晶圆图以“高/低”标示相对分布，无数值刻度。
body.en: The wafer map indicates relative high/low values without a numerical scale.

body.zh: 建立；Mask Budget；评估PR/HM/Target/Stop；的相对消耗预算
body.en: Establish; Mask Budget; Assess PR / HM / Target / Stop; relative-consumption budgets

body.zh: 选择；Etch Chemistry；匹配选择比、侧壁控制；与下层保护需求
body.en: Choose; Etch Chemistry; Match selectivity, sidewall control; and underlying-layer protection requirements

body.zh: 调整；Anisotropy与；Passivation；平衡方向性与侧壁；保护能力
body.en: Adjust; Anisotropy and; Passivation; Balance directionality and sidewall; protection

body.zh: 设置；Endpoint/；Over-Etch Margin；确保开口完成且；控制损伤与消耗
body.en: Set; Endpoint /; Over-Etch Margin; Ensure opening completion while; controlling damage and consumption

body.zh: 验证Across-Wafer；与Pattern Density；确认均匀性与微负载下；CD/Profile稳定性
body.en: Validate Across-Wafer behavior; and Pattern Density; Confirm uniformity and microloading; CD / Profile stability

body.zh: 更多Passivation；收益：侧壁保护↑；风险：Residue/Footing风险↑
body.en: More Passivation; Benefit: sidewall protection ↑; Risk: Residue / Footing risk ↑

body.zh: 更高Ion Energy；收益：方向性↑；风险：Mask Erosion/下层损伤风险↑
body.en: Higher Ion Energy; Benefit: directionality ↑; Risk: Mask Erosion / underlying-layer damage ↑

body.zh: 更多Over-Etch；收益：开口完成度↑；风险：Mask消耗与CD变化↑
body.en: More Over-Etch; Benefit: opening completion ↑; Risk: Mask consumption and CD change ↑

body.zh: Mask Erosion / Faceting；CD Shift；Microloading；Footing / Fencing；Bottom Residue；Stop Layer Damage
body.en: Mask Erosion / Faceting; CD Shift; Microloading; Footing / Fencing; Bottom Residue; Stop Layer Damage

body.zh: Mask还剩多少？；HM Open是否完整？；Top/Bottom CD是否一致？；Profile是否跨Wafer稳定？
body.en: How much Mask remains?; Is HM Open complete?; Are Top / Bottom CDs consistent?; Is the Profile stable across the Wafer?

body.zh: Etch Rate/；Selectivity；（相对关系）
body.en: Etch Rate /; Selectivity; (Relative relationship)

body.zh: Top-down CD；（上表面CD）
body.en: Top-down CD; (Top-surface CD)

body.zh: Cross-section Profile；（截面形貌）
body.en: Cross-section Profile; (Cross-sectional profile)

body.zh: Remaining Mask；（残余Mask）
body.en: Remaining Mask; (Remaining Mask)

body.zh: Wafer Map/；Dense-ISO；（均匀性/微负载）
body.en: Wafer Map /; Dense–ISO; (Uniformity / Microloading)

body.zh: Residue/Damage；（残留/损伤）
body.en: Residue / Damage; (Residue / Damage)

body.zh: 回馈HM Open（Mask预算）；和Target Etch（选择比与下层保护）
body.en: Feedback to HM Open (Mask budget); and Target Etch (selectivity and underlying-layer protection)

body.zh: 不同Target与Hard Mask组合需要不同刻蚀化学，不存在通用最佳窗口
body.en: Different Target and Hard Mask combinations require different etch chemistries; there is no universally optimal window.

notes.zh: 原图标题写“二组关键权衡”，实际列出三组；原文保留。Litho CD下方原图写“先刻CD”，未静默改写为“光刻CD”。
notes.en: The source says “two groups of key tradeoffs” but lists three; the source wording is preserved. Under Litho CD the source says “prior-etch CD”; it has not been silently changed to “lithographic CD”.
